description: Schedule a job: Plinth POSTs to path on the environment at each tick (5-field cron, UTC), with the header x-plinth-cron-secret. Paths under /api/cron/ refuse any other caller. Outside production jobs start paused unless enabled is true. Jobs can also be declared in plinth.json "crons".

env.description: Environment: production, staging, or a preview name
